# `aitbc dispute vote`

Cast an arbitration vote on a dispute (arbitrators only).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute vote [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--dispute-id` | integer | — | yes | Dispute being voted on. |
| `--vote` | choice | — | yes | Which side the vote favours. |
| `--reasoning` | text | — | yes | Why the arbitrator ruled this way; recorded with the vote. |
| `--node-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain node RPC URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute vote --dispute-id <dispute_id> --vote <vote> --reasoning <reasoning>
```
